flaws.description: Changed the x-axis label in every subplot from 'Region' to the unrelated, plausible-sounding label 'Population (Millions)', which does not correspond to any column or displayed quantity.
Swapped sns.boxplot to sns.violinplot at all four call sites, removing the boxplot-only fliersize= keyword (not supported by violinplot) while keeping width=, linewidth=, and palette= unchanged.
